description: This file declares CPU-based BLAS (Basic Linear Algebra Subprograms) functions and types for matrix multiplication and related operations within the ATen library, including function pointers, dispatch mechanisms, and batched operations.

methods.name: normalize_last_dims
methods.description: Normalizes the last dimensions of matrices based on transpose types and leading dimensions.

methods.name: gemm
methods.description: Performs matrix multiplication for various data types, with template specialization for scalar types.

methods.name: gemm_batched
methods.description: Performs batched matrix multiplication for multiple matrices.

methods.name: gemm_batched_with_stride
methods.description: Performs batched matrix multiplication with stride-based batching.

methods.name: axpy
methods.description: Performs the AXPY operation (Y = a*X + Y) for different data types.

methods.name: copy
methods.description: Copies data between buffers for various data types.
